answer: Fake identities cluster like water in karst: many mouths, one hidden river. Each epoch the network maps the transaction graph and flags any cluster whose internal links exceed 90% of its total links — a crystal-clear fingerprint of one operator. Three random auditors sample 20 of its transactions; if over half trace to one funding source, the whole cluster is quarantined and its rewards frozen three epochs. Faking a diverse graph for 1,000 puppets needs about 50,000 genuine cross-cluster trades per epoch, while an honest agent trades normally, pays nothing, and drifts through like a zephyr.
